spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m8p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Trains, Regions, BlocksPerRegion, EpochBound

Blocks == Regions \X (1 .. BlocksPerRegion)

NoRegion == "noregion"
NoBlock  == <<"noblock", 0>>
NoTrain  == "notrain"
NoStamp  == EpochBound + 1

RegionOf(b) == b[1]

VARIABLES epoch, coarse, stamp, fine, occ

vars == <<epoch, coarse, stamp, fine, occ>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0 .. EpochBound
  /\ coarse \in [Trains -> Regions \cup {NoRegion}]
  /\ stamp \in [Trains -> (0 .. EpochBound) \cup {NoStamp}]
  /\ fine \in [Trains -> Blocks \cup {NoBlock}]
  /\ occ \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {NoTrain}]

UnderWay(t) == \E b \in Blocks : occ[b] = t

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ coarse = [t \in Trains |-> NoRegion]
  /\ stamp = [t \in Trains |-> NoStamp]
  /\ fine = [t \in Trains |-> NoBlock]
  /\ occ = [b \in Blocks |-> NoTrain]

\* Coarse rung: the region authority is exclusive and is stamped with the epoch
\* that was current when the interlocking handed it over.
TakeRegion(t, r) ==
  /\ coarse[t] = NoRegion
  /\ \A u \in Trains \ {t} : coarse[u] # r
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![t] = r]
  /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![t] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, fine, occ>>

\* Fine rung: only a train whose coarse stamp is still current may reach for a
\* block, and only for a block inside the region it already holds.
TakeBlock(t, b) ==
  /\ coarse[t] = RegionOf(b)
  /\ stamp[t] = epoch
  /\ fine[t] = NoBlock
  /\ occ[b] = NoTrain
  /\ \A u \in Trains \ {t} : fine[u] # b
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![t] = b]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, coarse, stamp, occ>>

Roll(t) ==
  /\ fine[t] # NoBlock
  /\ stamp[t] = epoch
  /\ occ[fine[t]] = NoTrain
  /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![fine[t]] = t]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, coarse, stamp, fine>>

Clear(t) ==
  /\ UnderWay(t)
  /\ occ' = [b \in Blocks |-> IF occ[b] = t THEN NoTrain ELSE occ[b]]
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![t] = NoBlock]
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![t] = NoRegion]
  /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![t] = NoStamp]
  /\ UNCHANGED epoch

\* Re-issuing the timetable advances the epoch. Trains already inside a block are
\* re-confirmed; anyone else silently becomes stale.
Reissue ==
  /\ epoch < EpochBound
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ stamp' = [t \in Trains |-> IF UnderWay(t) THEN epoch + 1 ELSE stamp[t]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, occ>>

\* Slow, not failed: a stale train always retains the ability to give its
\* authority back and re-queue.
DropStale(t) ==
  /\ ~UnderWay(t)
  /\ stamp[t] # NoStamp
  /\ stamp[t] # epoch
  /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![t] = NoStamp]
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![t] = NoRegion]
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![t] = NoBlock]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, occ>>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Trains : \E r \in Regions : TakeRegion(t, r)
  \/ \E t \in Trains : \E b \in Blocks : TakeBlock(t, b)
  \/ \E t \in Trains : Roll(t) \/ Clear(t) \/ DropStale(t)
  \/ Reissue

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Nothing rolling is stale or unauthorized: the occupant of a block still owns
\* the fine authority for that exact block and its coarse stamp is current.
NoStaleOccupancy ==
  \A b \in Blocks :
    occ[b] # NoTrain => /\ fine[occ[b]] = b
                        /\ stamp[occ[b]] = epoch
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Trains = {"t1", "t2"}
    Regions = {"r1", "r2"}
    BlocksPerRegion = 2
    EpochBound = 2
INVARIANT NoStaleOccupancy
nl:
A metropolitan subway signalling installation divides its running track into
regions, and each region into numbered signalling blocks. Before a train may
roll into a block it must climb a two-level authority ladder held by the
interlocking: first it takes the coarse region authority for the region that
contains the block, and only then may it take the fine authority for the
individual block. Every coarse grant is stamped with the interlocking's current
issue epoch. The interlocking periodically re-issues the region timetable,
which advances the epoch; any train that is already under way inside a block
has its stamp re-confirmed as part of the re-issue, while a train that is merely
holding paper authority on a platform is left carrying an epoch that no longer
matches. Trains on this network are slow but never failed: a train sitting on a
stale stamp will always eventually notice and hand its coarse and fine authority
back, after which it may queue for a fresh grant. The full action set is: a train
takes coarse region authority and receives a stamp at the current epoch; a train
holding fresh coarse authority for a region takes fine authority for one free
block inside that region; a train holding fresh coarse and fine authority rolls
into its block; a train inside a block clears the block and surrenders both
levels of authority; the interlocking re-issues the region and advances the epoch,
re-confirming stamps only for trains already under way; and a train that
discovers its stamp is stale drops its coarse and fine authority without moving.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every occupied signalling block is occupied by a train that
still holds fine authority for exactly that block and whose coarse stamp equals
the interlocking's current epoch, so no stale or unauthorized train is ever on
the track.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od8m7p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Clients, VerBound, Seats

Claims == [c : Clients, v : 0 .. VerBound]

VARIABLES ver, seats, pool, holds, outcome, log

vars == <<ver, seats, pool, holds, outcome, log>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ ver \in 0 .. VerBound
  /\ seats \in 0 .. Seats
  /\ pool \in SUBSET Claims
  /\ holds \in SUBSET Clients
  /\ outcome \in [Clients -> {"idle", "pending", "accepted", "refused"}]
  /\ log \in SUBSET Claims

Init ==
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ seats = Seats
  /\ pool = {}
  /\ holds = {}
  /\ outcome = [c \in Clients |-> "idle"]
  /\ log = {}

Grant(c) ==
  /\ c \notin holds
  /\ outcome[c] = "idle"
  /\ holds' = holds \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, seats, pool, outcome, log>>

\* A client posts the version it read; the pool is a set, so the registrar is
\* free to serve claims in any order at all.
Post(c) ==
  /\ c \in holds
  /\ outcome[c] = "idle"
  /\ pool' = pool \cup {[c |-> c, v |-> ver]}
  /\ outcome' = [outcome EXCEPT ![c] = "pending"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, seats, holds, log>>

Fresh(m) ==
  /\ m.v = ver
  /\ m.c \in holds
  /\ seats > 0
  /\ ver < VerBound

\* Compare-and-swap: the observed version must still be the live one, otherwise
\* the write is someone else's stale news and is refused.
Accept(m) ==
  /\ m \in pool
  /\ Fresh(m)
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ seats' = seats - 1
  /\ log' = log \cup {m}
  /\ pool' = pool \ {m}
  /\ outcome' = [outcome EXCEPT ![m.c] = "accepted"]
  /\ UNCHANGED holds

Refuse(m) ==
  /\ m \in pool
  /\ ~Fresh(m)
  /\ pool' = pool \ {m}
  /\ outcome' = [outcome EXCEPT ![m.c] = "refused"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, seats, holds, log>>

Revoke(c) ==
  /\ c \in holds
  /\ holds' = holds \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, seats, pool, outcome, log>>

Retire(c) ==
  /\ outcome[c] \in {"accepted", "refused"}
  /\ outcome' = [outcome EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, seats, pool, holds, log>>

\* Every claim a client has outstanding can always be answered one way or another.
Resolve(c) == \E m \in pool : m.c = c /\ (Accept(m) \/ Refuse(m))

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Clients : Grant(c) \/ Post(c) \/ Revoke(c) \/ Retire(c)
  \/ \E m \in Claims : Accept(m) \/ Refuse(m)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A c \in Clients : WF_vars(Resolve(c))

\* The accepted-writes log holds exactly one entry per version below the live
\* version: no gap (a version advanced without a write) and no duplicate (two
\* writes landing on the same version, which is what a stale accept would do).
LogIsGaplessPrefix ==
  /\ {m.v : m \in log} = 0 .. (ver - 1)
  /\ \A m1, m2 \in log : m1.v = m2.v => m1 = m2

EveryClaimAnswered ==
  \A c \in Clients : (outcome[c] = "pending") ~> (outcome[c] # "pending")
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Clients = {"c1", "c2"}
    VerBound = 3
    Seats = 2
INVARIANT LogIsGaplessPrefix
PROPERTY EveryClaimAnswered
nl:
A university course-registration system keeps the remaining seat count for a
popular course in a single compare-and-swap register guarded by a version
number. A student's client is admitted to the queue when the registrar grants it
a registration hold. A holding client reads the register and posts a seat-claim
message carrying the version it observed. The campus network does not preserve
order: posted claims sit in an unordered pool and the registrar may pick up any
waiting claim before any other, so a claim written against an old version can
easily arrive after a newer claim has already landed. The registrar accepts a
claim only if the version it carries still matches the register, the sending
client still holds a live registration hold, and seats remain; accepting the
claim decrements the seat count, bumps the version, and writes the claim into the
accepted-writes log. Any claim failing those conditions is turned away as stale
or unauthorized. The registrar may also revoke a client's hold at any moment,
which makes that client's outstanding claim unauthorized. A client whose claim
has been answered may retire the result and go back to idle, and a client with no
hold may be granted one again. The full action set is: grant a hold, post a
claim, accept a claim, turn a claim away, revoke a hold, and retire a finished
result.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The accepted-writes log is a gapless, duplicate-free record of
exactly the versions zero through one below the register's current version, so no
stale or unauthorized claim was ever accepted.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every posted claim is eventually answered, so no client is
left waiting in the pending state forever.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m2p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Branches, Reqs

NoReq == "noreq"

VARIABLES master, decision, votes, cur, view

vars == <<master, decision, votes, cur, view>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ master \in SUBSET Reqs
  /\ decision \in [Reqs -> {"none", "commit", "abort"}]
  /\ votes \in [Branches -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
  /\ cur \in Reqs \cup {NoReq}
  /\ view \in [Branches -> SUBSET Reqs]

Init ==
  /\ master = {}
  /\ decision = [x \in Reqs |-> "none"]
  /\ votes = [b \in Branches |-> "none"]
  /\ cur = NoReq
  /\ view = [b \in Branches |-> {}]

Open(x) ==
  /\ cur = NoReq
  /\ decision[x] = "none"
  /\ cur' = x
  /\ votes' = [b \in Branches |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<master, decision, view>>

\* Prepare phase. A slow branch simply has not answered yet; there is no timeout
\* that would let the coordinator move on without it.
Vote(b, v) ==
  /\ cur # NoReq
  /\ votes[b] = "none"
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<master, decision, cur, view>>

\* Commit phase. The decision and the write into the shared record happen in one
\* step, which is what keeps a committed reservation from being lost.
Commit ==
  /\ cur # NoReq
  /\ \A b \in Branches : votes[b] = "yes"
  /\ master' = master \cup {cur}
  /\ decision' = [decision EXCEPT ![cur] = "commit"]
  /\ cur' = NoReq
  /\ votes' = [b \in Branches |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED view

Abort ==
  /\ cur # NoReq
  /\ \E b \in Branches : votes[b] = "no"
  /\ decision' = [decision EXCEPT ![cur] = "abort"]
  /\ cur' = NoReq
  /\ votes' = [b \in Branches |-> "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<master, view>>

\* A lagging branch folds one already-committed entry into its own copy.
Install(b, x) ==
  /\ x \in master
  /\ x \notin view[b]
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![b] = view[b] \cup {x}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<master, decision, votes, cur>>

\* Once every branch has the entry the hold has served its purpose and is retired
\* from the active record; record and copies are trimmed together.
Retire(x) ==
  /\ x \in master
  /\ \A b \in Branches : x \in view[b]
  /\ cur = NoReq
  /\ master' = master \ {x}
  /\ decision' = [decision EXCEPT ![x] = "none"]
  /\ view' = [b \in Branches |-> view[b] \ {x}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, cur>>

Retry(x) ==
  /\ decision[x] = "abort"
  /\ cur = NoReq
  /\ decision' = [decision EXCEPT ![x] = "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<master, votes, cur, view>>

Next ==
  \/ \E x \in Reqs : Open(x) \/ Retire(x) \/ Retry(x)
  \/ \E b \in Branches : \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(b, v)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ \E b \in Branches : \E x \in Reqs : Install(b, x)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The shared record is exactly the committed set, and no branch copy runs ahead
\* of it: an update is neither lost on commit nor invented anywhere.
NoLostUpdate ==
  /\ master = {x \in Reqs : decision[x] = "commit"}
  /\ \A b \in Branches : view[b] \subseteq master
====
nl:
A city library runs book reservations against one shared holds record that every
branch must agree on. Each reservation request is pushed through a two-phase
commit: the reservations coordinator opens exactly one request at a time and asks
every branch to prepare it. A branch answers yes or no according to whether its
own shelf state allows the hold. Branches here are slow but never failed - a
branch may take an arbitrary amount of time to answer, and an arbitrary amount of
time afterwards to fold the result into its own local copy of the record, but it
never drops out. If every branch answers yes the coordinator records the request
as committed and writes it into the shared holds record in the same step; if any
branch answers no the coordinator records the request as aborted and the shared
record is left untouched. Either way the round closes and the coordinator is free
to open the next request. Separately, and at its own pace, a lagging branch pulls
one committed entry it does not yet have from the shared record into its local
copy. Once every branch has installed a committed entry the hold has done its work, and
the coordinator retires it, striking it from the shared record and from every
local copy in one step. A request that was aborted may be put back on the queue
for another attempt. The full action set is: open a request, cast a branch vote,
commit a unanimously approved request into the shared record, abort a request
that drew a no vote, let a lagging branch install one missing committed entry,
retire a fully propagated entry, and requeue an aborted request.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared holds record contains exactly those requests the
coordinator recorded as committed - no committed reservation is ever missing from
it and no uncommitted reservation ever appears in it - and no branch's local copy
ever contains an entry the shared record does not.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m3p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Branches, MsgIds, Copies, TermBound

NoLeader == "noleader"

Parcels == [id : MsgIds, to : Branches]

VARIABLES term, leader, shelf, transit, down

vars == <<term, leader, shelf, transit, down>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in 0 .. (TermBound - 1)
  /\ leader \in Branches \cup {NoLeader}
  /\ shelf \in [Branches -> 0 .. Copies]
  /\ transit \in SUBSET Parcels
  /\ down \in SUBSET Branches

\* Copies live either on a shelf or inside exactly one parcel.
OnShelves ==
  LET g[S \in SUBSET Branches] ==
        IF S = {} THEN 0
        ELSE LET b == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN shelf[b] + g[S \ {b}]
  IN g[Branches]

Init ==
  /\ term = 0
  /\ leader = NoLeader
  /\ shelf = [b \in Branches |-> IF b = CHOOSE x \in Branches : TRUE THEN Copies ELSE 0]
  /\ transit = {}
  /\ down = {}

\* Leadership rotates through a bounded window of terms so the model stays finite.
Elect(b) ==
  /\ leader = NoLeader
  /\ b \notin down
  /\ leader' = b
  /\ term' = (term + 1) % TermBound
  /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, transit, down>>

LeaderDown ==
  /\ leader # NoLeader
  /\ down' = down \cup {leader}
  /\ leader' = NoLeader
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, shelf, transit>>

\* Dispatch removes the copy from the shelf in the very same step that puts it in
\* the pool, which is what keeps the total fixed across a failover.
Dispatch(from, to, i) ==
  /\ leader # NoLeader
  /\ from # to
  /\ shelf[from] > 0
  /\ \A m \in transit : m.id # i
  /\ shelf' = [shelf EXCEPT ![from] = shelf[from] - 1]
  /\ transit' = transit \cup {[id |-> i, to |-> to]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, down>>

\* The pool is a set, so any waiting parcel may land next.
Deliver(m) ==
  /\ m \in transit
  /\ transit' = transit \ {m}
  /\ shelf' = [shelf EXCEPT ![m.to] = shelf[m.to] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, down>>

Recover(b) ==
  /\ b \in down
  /\ down' = down \ {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, shelf, transit>>

DeliverId(i) == \E m \in transit : m.id = i /\ Deliver(m)

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Branches : Elect(b) \/ Recover(b)
  \/ LeaderDown
  \/ \E f, t \in Branches : \E i \in MsgIds : Dispatch(f, t, i)
  \/ \E m \in Parcels : Deliver(m)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A i \in MsgIds : WF_vars(DeliverId(i))

\* Conservation: every copy is on exactly one shelf or in exactly one parcel.
CopiesConserved == OnShelves + Cardinality(transit) = Copies

EveryParcelLands ==
  \A i \in MsgIds :
    (\E m \in transit : m.id = i) ~> (\A m \in transit : m.id # i)
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Branches = {"b1", "b2"}
    MsgIds = {"p1", "p2"}
    Copies = 2
    TermBound = 3
INVARIANT CopiesConserved
PROPERTY EveryParcelLands
nl:
A library consortium moves physical copies of a title between branches to satisfy
reservations. Transfers are authorized by whichever branch currently holds the
consortium leadership: a leader is elected for a term, and if the leader goes
down the seat is vacated and a surviving branch is elected for the next term, so
authority fails over rather than disappearing. Terms are tracked in a small
rotating window. The courier network does not preserve order - a dispatched copy
becomes an in-transit parcel sitting in an unordered pool, and parcels may be
delivered in any order whatsoever, so a copy dispatched later can easily arrive
first. Dispatching a copy takes it off the sending branch's shelf at that
instant and puts it into the parcel pool; delivery takes it out of the pool and
puts it on the receiving branch's shelf. No step ever creates or destroys a copy:
a copy is on exactly one shelf or in exactly one parcel at all times. A branch
that has gone down may come back up and rejoin. The full action set is: elect a
leader for the next term, have the sitting leader go down and vacate the seat,
dispatch a copy from a shelf into the parcel pool under the sitting leader's
authority, deliver any waiting parcel to its destination shelf, and bring a
downed branch back up.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of copies sitting on branch shelves plus the number
of copies riding in the parcel pool always equals the consortium's fixed total,
so leader failover and out-of-order delivery never create or lose a copy.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every dispatched parcel is eventually delivered, so no copy
stays stranded in the courier pool forever.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m2p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Services, Branches, Ballots

NoService == "noservice"

VARIABLES phase, ballot, enlisted, token, votes

vars == <<phase, ballot, enlisted, token, votes>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ phase \in [Services -> {"idle", "preparing", "committed", "aborted"}]
  /\ ballot \in [Services -> 0 .. (Ballots - 1)]
  /\ enlisted \in [Branches -> Services \cup {NoService}]
  /\ token \in [Branches -> 0 .. (Ballots - 1)]
  /\ votes \in [Services -> [Branches -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]]

Crew(k) == {b \in Branches : enlisted[b] = k}

Init ==
  /\ phase = [k \in Services |-> "idle"]
  /\ ballot = [k \in Services |-> 0]
  /\ enlisted = [b \in Branches |-> NoService]
  /\ token = [b \in Branches |-> 0]
  /\ votes = [k \in Services |-> [b \in Branches |-> "none"]]

Open(k) ==
  /\ phase[k] = "idle"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![k] = "preparing"]
  /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![k] = (ballot[k] + 1) % Ballots]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![k] = [b \in Branches |-> "none"]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<enlisted, token>>

\* The shared pool: a branch answers to at most one service at a time, and takes
\* that service's live ballot as its enlistment token.
Enlist(k, b) ==
  /\ phase[k] = "preparing"
  /\ enlisted[b] = NoService
  /\ enlisted' = [enlisted EXCEPT ![b] = k]
  /\ token' = [token EXCEPT ![b] = ballot[k]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, ballot, votes>>

Refresh(b) ==
  /\ enlisted[b] # NoService
  /\ token[b] # ballot[enlisted[b]]
  /\ token' = [token EXCEPT ![b] = ballot[enlisted[b]]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, ballot, enlisted, votes>>

\* A vote counts only from an enlisted branch carrying a current token.
CastVote(k, b, v) ==
  /\ phase[k] = "preparing"
  /\ enlisted[b] = k
  /\ token[b] = ballot[k]
  /\ votes[k][b] = "none"
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![k][b] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, ballot, enlisted, token>>

Commit(k) ==
  /\ phase[k] = "preparing"
  /\ Crew(k) # {}
  /\ \A b \in Crew(k) : votes[k][b] = "yes"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![k] = "committed"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, enlisted, token, votes>>

Abort(k) ==
  /\ phase[k] = "preparing"
  /\ \E b \in Branches : votes[k][b] = "no"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![k] = "aborted"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, enlisted, token, votes>>

\* Retrying advances the ballot and wipes the tally, stranding the crew on stale
\* tokens until each one refreshes.
Retry(k) ==
  /\ phase[k] = "preparing"
  /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![k] = (ballot[k] + 1) % Ballots]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![k] = [b \in Branches |-> "none"]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, enlisted, token>>

Close(k) ==
  /\ phase[k] \in {"committed", "aborted"}
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![k] = "idle"]
  /\ enlisted' = [b \in Branches |-> IF enlisted[b] = k THEN NoService ELSE enlisted[b]]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![k] = [b \in Branches |-> "none"]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, token>>

Next ==
  \/ \E k \in Services : Open(k) \/ Commit(k) \/ Abort(k) \/ Retry(k) \/ Close(k)
  \/ \E k \in Services : \E b \in Branches : Enlist(k, b)
  \/ \E k \in Services : \E b \in Branches : \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(k, b, v)
  \/ \E b \in Branches : Refresh(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every recorded vote belongs to a branch still enlisted with that service and
\* still carrying that service's live ballot.
NoStaleVote ==
  \A k \in Services : \A b \in Branches :
    votes[k][b] # "none" => (enlisted[b] = k /\ token[b] = ballot[k])
====
nl:
Two library reservation services - the public catalogue and the interlibrary loan
desk - run side by side over one shared pool of branch participants. Each service
commits its reservations with its own independent two-phase commit, but the two
compete for the same branches: a branch can be enlisted in at most one service's
round at a time. A service opens a round by stamping it with a fresh ballot
number and clearing any votes it had recorded. Enlisting a free branch hands that
branch the service's current ballot as its enlistment token. A branch may cast a
prepare vote only for the service it is actually enlisted with, and only while
the token it is carrying still equals that service's live ballot. A service that
loses patience may retry its round, which advances its ballot and wipes its vote
tally; every branch still enlisted with it is thereby left holding a stale token
and must take a refreshed token before it can vote again. When every branch
enlisted with a service has voted yes the service commits; a single no vote
aborts it. Closing a finished round releases that service's branches back into
the shared pool. The full action set is: open a round, enlist a free branch,
refresh a stale enlistment token, cast a vote, commit, abort, retry a round with a
new ballot, and close a finished round.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every vote a service has on its tally was cast by a branch that
is currently enlisted with that very service and whose enlistment token still
matches that service's live ballot, so no unauthorized branch and no branch
holding a stale token ever contributes to a decision.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m7p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Gateways, VerBound

Admin == "supervisor"
Unwritten == "unwritten"
NoSnap == VerBound + 1
NoAck == VerBound + 1

VARIABLES ver, ledger, snap, ack, phase

vars == <<ver, ledger, snap, ack, phase>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ ver \in 0 .. VerBound
  /\ ledger \in [0 .. VerBound -> Gateways \cup {Admin, Unwritten}]
  /\ snap \in [Gateways -> (0 .. VerBound) \cup {NoSnap}]
  /\ ack \in [Gateways -> (0 .. VerBound) \cup {NoAck}]
  /\ phase \in [Gateways -> {"idle", "posted", "answered"}]

Init ==
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ ledger = [v \in 0 .. VerBound |-> Unwritten]
  /\ snap = [g \in Gateways |-> NoSnap]
  /\ ack = [g \in Gateways |-> NoAck]
  /\ phase = [g \in Gateways |-> "idle"]

Post(g) ==
  /\ phase[g] = "idle"
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![g] = ver]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "posted"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, ledger, ack>>

Writable(g) == phase[g] = "posted" /\ snap[g] = ver /\ ver < VerBound

\* Compare-and-swap: the snapshot must still be the live version. Acceptance
\* stamps the author into the ledger slot for the version it just consumed.
Accept(g) ==
  /\ Writable(g)
  /\ ledger' = [ledger EXCEPT ![ver] = g]
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ ack' = [ack EXCEPT ![g] = ver]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "answered"]
  /\ UNCHANGED snap

TurnAway(g) ==
  /\ phase[g] = "posted"
  /\ ~Writable(g)
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "answered"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, ledger, snap, ack>>

\* The supervisor's override needs no snapshot, but it still consumes its own
\* version slot rather than writing over one already spoken for.
Override ==
  /\ ver < VerBound
  /\ ledger' = [ledger EXCEPT ![ver] = Admin]
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, ack, phase>>

Reset(g) ==
  /\ phase[g] = "answered"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "idle"]
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![g] = NoSnap]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, ledger, ack>>

Answer(g) == Accept(g) \/ TurnAway(g)

Next ==
  \/ \E g \in Gateways : Post(g) \/ Accept(g) \/ TurnAway(g) \/ Reset(g)
  \/ Override

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A g \in Gateways : WF_vars(Answer(g))

\* An acknowledged write is still attributed to its author and sits strictly
\* below the live version: nothing, override included, displaced it.
NoLostUpdate ==
  \A g \in Gateways :
    ack[g] # NoAck => (ledger[ack[g]] = g /\ ack[g] < ver)

EveryPostAnswered ==
  \A g \in Gateways : (phase[g] = "posted") ~> (phase[g] # "posted")
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Gateways = {"g1", "g2"}
    VerBound = 3
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
PROPERTY EveryPostAnswered
nl:
During a stock exchange's opening auction the indicative opening price is held in
a single compare-and-swap register carried by a version counter, and every
accepted change is stamped into the auction's provenance ledger: slot v of the
ledger names whoever wrote the version-v change. A broker gateway works in the
usual optimistic style - it reads the register's current version as a snapshot,
posts its price update against that snapshot, and the register accepts the update
only if the snapshot still equals the live version. Acceptance stamps the
gateway's name into the ledger slot for that version, advances the version, and
hands the gateway an acknowledgement naming the version its update landed at. If
the snapshot has gone out of date the post is turned away and the gateway must
start over. The exchange supervisor holds a privileged override: it can force a
price into the register without holding any snapshot at all, but the override is
not exempt from the ledger - it stamps itself into the current slot and advances
the version exactly like an ordinary write, so a forced change can never
silently overwrite somebody else's recorded change. A gateway that has been
answered clears its snapshot and returns to idle. The full action set is: a
gateway reads a snapshot and posts, the register accepts a fresh post, the
register turns away a stale post, the supervisor forces an override write, and an
answered gateway resets.

SAFETY PROPERTY: For every acknowledgement a gateway holds, the auction ledger
slot named by that acknowledgement still records that same gateway as the author
and lies strictly below the live version, so no accepted update is ever lost or
re-attributed - not even by the supervisor's override.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every posted price update is eventually answered, either
accepted or turned away, so no gateway is left posted forever.

---- MODULE W4Od14m8p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Drones, Sectors, CellsPerSector, SectorCap, AirCap

Cells == Sectors \X (1 .. CellsPerSector)

NoSector == "nosector"
NoCell == <<"nocell", 0>>

SectorOf(c) == c[1]

VARIABLES sector, cell, flying, acked, closed

vars == <<sector, cell, flying, acked, closed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ sector \in [Drones -> Sectors \cup {NoSector}]
  /\ cell \in [Drones -> Cells \cup {NoCell}]
  /\ flying \in SUBSET Drones
  /\ acked \in [Drones -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ closed \in SUBSET Sectors

Holders(s) == {d \in Drones : sector[d] = s}

Init ==
  /\ sector = [d \in Drones |-> NoSector]
  /\ cell = [d \in Drones |-> NoCell]
  /\ flying = {}
  /\ acked = [d \in Drones |-> FALSE]
  /\ closed = {}

\* Coarse rung: the sector ration is charged the moment the clearance is issued,
\* not when the drone gets round to using it.
Clear(d, s) ==
  /\ sector[d] = NoSector
  /\ s \notin closed
  /\ Cardinality(Holders(s)) < SectorCap
  /\ sector' = [sector EXCEPT ![d] = s]
  /\ acked' = [acked EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cell, flying, closed>>

\* Slow but not failed: the drone always still has the ability to confirm.
Confirm(d) ==
  /\ sector[d] # NoSector
  /\ ~acked[d]
  /\ acked' = [acked EXCEPT ![d] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sector, cell, flying, closed>>

\* Fine rung: an orbit cell inside the drone's own cleared sector, taken only
\* after the clearance has been confirmed.
ClaimCell(d, c) ==
  /\ acked[d]
  /\ sector[d] = SectorOf(c)
  /\ cell[d] = NoCell
  /\ \A e \in Drones \ {d} : cell[e] # c
  /\ cell' = [cell EXCEPT ![d] = c]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sector, flying, acked, closed>>

Launch(d) ==
  /\ cell[d] # NoCell
  /\ d \notin flying
  /\ Cardinality(flying) < AirCap
  /\ flying' = flying \cup {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sector, cell, acked, closed>>

Land(d) ==
  /\ d \in flying
  /\ flying' = flying \ {d}
  /\ cell' = [cell EXCEPT ![d] = NoCell]
  /\ sector' = [sector EXCEPT ![d] = NoSector]
  /\ acked' = [acked EXCEPT ![d] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED closed

CloseSector(s) ==
  /\ s \notin closed
  /\ Holders(s) = {}
  /\ closed' = closed \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sector, cell, flying, acked>>

OpenSector(s) ==
  /\ s \in closed
  /\ closed' = closed \ {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<sector, cell, flying, acked>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones : \E s \in Sectors : Clear(d, s)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : \E c \in Cells : ClaimCell(d, c)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Confirm(d) \/ Launch(d) \/ Land(d)
  \/ \E s \in Sectors : CloseSector(s) \/ OpenSector(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity at both rungs: per-sector clearance ration and the swarm's
\* overall airborne ceiling.
CapacityRespected ==
  /\ \A s \in Sectors : Cardinality(Holders(s)) =< SectorCap
  /\ Cardinality(flying) =< AirCap
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {"d1", "d2", "d3"}
    Sectors = {"s1", "s2"}
    CellsPerSector = 2
    SectorCap = 2
    AirCap = 2
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A wildfire surveillance swarm flies drones over a burn perimeter that the incident
tower has carved into sectors, each sector holding a fixed number of numbered
orbit cells. Airspace is rationed at two levels and a drone must climb both rungs
in order. First the tower issues a coarse sector clearance, and it will only
issue one while that sector is open and is holding fewer clearances than its
posted sector ceiling. A drone that has been issued a clearance is slow but never
failed: it may take an arbitrary stretch of time before it confirms the clearance
back to the tower, and until it confirms it may not proceed, but it always
remains in the swarm and its clearance keeps occupying a slot in the sector's
ration the whole time. Once confirmed, the drone takes the fine rung by claiming
a specific free orbit cell inside its own cleared sector. Only then may it
launch, and the tower will not let it launch unless the number of drones already
in the air is below the swarm's overall airborne ceiling. Landing releases the
orbit cell, the sector clearance and the confirmation together. The tower may
close a sector against a wind shift, but only while no drone holds a clearance
for it, and may reopen a closed sector later. The full action set is: issue a
sector clearance, confirm a clearance, claim an orbit cell, launch, land, close an
empty sector, and reopen a closed sector.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No sector ever holds more clearances than its posted sector
ceiling and the number of drones in the air never exceeds the swarm's airborne
ceiling.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od13m1p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS RingSize, Orders, MaxCap

Machines == 1 .. RingSize
NoMachine == 0

VARIABLES token, state, sealed, owner, stock, cap

vars == <<token, state, sealed, owner, stock, cap>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Machines
  /\ state \in [Orders -> {"new", "ready", "jammed", "drawn"}]
  /\ sealed \in SUBSET Orders
  /\ owner \in [Orders -> Machines \cup {NoMachine}]
  /\ stock \in 0 .. MaxCap
  /\ cap \in 1 .. MaxCap

Init ==
  /\ token = 1
  /\ state = [o \in Orders |-> "new"]
  /\ sealed = {}
  /\ owner = [o \in Orders |-> NoMachine]
  /\ stock = MaxCap
  /\ cap = MaxCap

Place(o, m) ==
  /\ state[o] = "new"
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![o] = "ready"]
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![o] = m]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, sealed, stock, cap>>

\* The irreversible step: money is drawn and the order goes into the sealed book
\* in the same instant, and only the token holder may do it.
Draw(o) ==
  /\ state[o] = "ready"
  /\ owner[o] = token
  /\ o \notin sealed
  /\ stock > 0
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![o] = "drawn"]
  /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {o}
  /\ stock' = stock - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, owner, cap>>

Jam(o) ==
  /\ state[o] = "ready"
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![o] = "jammed"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, sealed, owner, stock, cap>>

\* A jammed order may be re-offered, but never one whose money was already drawn.
Reoffer(o) ==
  /\ state[o] = "jammed"
  /\ o \notin sealed
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![o] = "ready"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, sealed, owner, stock, cap>>

PassToken ==
  /\ token' = (token % RingSize) + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<state, sealed, owner, stock, cap>>

Restock ==
  /\ stock < cap
  /\ stock' = stock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, state, sealed, owner, cap>>

\* Capacity is reset by the route driver while the machine is running.
SetCap(c) ==
  /\ c # cap
  /\ cap' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, state, sealed, owner, stock>>

Next ==
  \/ \E o \in Orders : \E m \in Machines : Place(o, m)
  \/ \E o \in Orders : Draw(o) \/ Jam(o) \/ Reoffer(o)
  \/ PassToken
  \/ Restock
  \/ \E c \in 1 .. MaxCap : SetCap(c)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ WF_vars(PassToken)

\* At most once: an order in the sealed book is never back on the ready list, so
\* it can never be drawn a second time.
NeverReoffered ==
  \A o \in Orders : o \in sealed => state[o] # "ready"

TokenCirculates ==
  \A m \in Machines : (token # m) ~> (token = m)
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    RingSize = 3
    Orders = {"o1", "o2"}
    MaxCap = 2
INVARIANT NeverReoffered
PROPERTY TokenCirculates
nl:
A route of networked vending machines shares one settlement line to the payment
processor, and access to that line is granted by a single token passed round the
machines in a fixed ring order. The irreversible step in this system is the
dispense-and-charge: when a machine dispenses an item it draws the customer's
money in the same motion, and that draw can never be undone, so an order must
never be dispensed a second time. Each order is placed against one machine and
sits ready; only the machine currently holding the token may dispense a ready
order it owns, and only while the machine has stock on hand. Dispensing takes the
order off the ready list, decrements stock, and writes the order into the sealed
book, which is the permanent record of orders whose money has been drawn. Orders
can also jam - a ready order may fail, and a failed order can be put back on the
ready list for another try, but the sealed book is consulted first and an order
already in it is never re-offered. The bay capacity is not fixed: a route driver
may reset the machine's bay capacity at any time while on site, and restocking is
allowed only while stock is below the capacity currently in force. The token keeps
moving round the ring regardless of what else is happening. The full action set
is: place an order against a machine, dispense and charge a ready order under the
token, jam a ready order, re-offer a jammed order, pass the token to the next
machine in the ring, restock a unit, and reset the bay capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No order that is already recorded in the sealed book is ever
sitting on the ready list, so the irreversible dispense-and-charge can happen at
most once per order.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: The token keeps circulating, so from any point every machine
in the ring eventually holds it again.

---- MODULE W4Od7m1p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Berths, Containers, RingSize, SealBound

Cranes == 1 .. RingSize
Quay == 1
NoBerth == "noberth"
NoSeal == SealBound + 1

Step(p) == (p % RingSize) + 1

VARIABLES token, claim, seal, nextSeal, state

vars == <<token, claim, seal, nextSeal, state>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in [Berths -> Cranes]
  /\ claim \in [Containers -> Berths \cup {NoBerth}]
  /\ seal \in [Containers -> (0 .. SealBound) \cup {NoSeal}]
  /\ nextSeal \in 0 .. SealBound
  /\ state \in [Containers -> {"stowed", "staged", "released"}]

Init ==
  /\ token = [k \in Berths |-> 1]
  /\ claim = [c \in Containers |-> NoBerth]
  /\ seal = [c \in Containers |-> NoSeal]
  /\ nextSeal = 0
  /\ state = [c \in Containers |-> "stowed"]

\* Two loops, one ring: a token steps to the next crane and hops over the crane
\* the other loop is holding.
PassToken(k) ==
  /\ LET p == Step(token[k])
         q == IF \E j \in Berths \ {k} : token[j] = p THEN Step(p) ELSE p
     IN token' = [token EXCEPT ![k] = q]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<claim, seal, nextSeal, state>>

\* The container pool is shared: whichever loop asks first stages it.
Assign(k, c) ==
  /\ state[c] = "stowed"
  /\ claim[c] = NoBerth
  /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![c] = k]
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![c] = "staged"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, seal, nextSeal>>

\* The irreversible act. It needs the quay crane, and it refuses any container
\* that already carries a seal number.
BreakSeal(k, c) ==
  /\ token[k] = Quay
  /\ claim[c] = k
  /\ state[c] = "staged"
  /\ seal[c] = NoSeal
  /\ nextSeal < SealBound
  /\ seal' = [seal EXCEPT ![c] = nextSeal]
  /\ nextSeal' = nextSeal + 1
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![c] = "released"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, claim>>

HandBack(c) ==
  /\ state[c] = "released"
  /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![c] = NoBerth]
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![c] = "stowed"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, seal, nextSeal>>

StandDown(c) ==
  /\ state[c] = "staged"
  /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![c] = NoBerth]
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![c] = "stowed"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, seal, nextSeal>>

Next ==
  \/ \E k \in Berths : PassToken(k)
  \/ \E k \in Berths : \E c \in Containers : Assign(k, c) \/ BreakSeal(k, c)
  \/ \E c \in Containers : HandBack(c) \/ StandDown(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The seal book has no gaps and no shared numbers: each drawn number belongs to
\* exactly one container, which is only possible if no seal was broken twice.
SealBookIsGapless ==
  ({seal[c] : c \in Containers} \ {NoSeal}) = 0 .. (nextSeal - 1)
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Berths = {"A", "B"}
    Containers = {"c1", "c2"}
    RingSize = 3
    SealBound = 3
INVARIANT SealBookIsGapless
nl:
A container-ship terminal runs two berth control loops side by side, and both
draw on one shared pool of yard cranes arranged in a ring. Each loop holds a
token that sits on one crane of the ring; passing a token advances it to the next
crane, skipping the crane the other loop's token is sitting on, so the two tokens
are never on the same crane. One position on the ring is the quay crane, and the
irreversible act of this terminal - breaking a container's customs seal and
releasing it into the yard - can only be performed by a berth loop while its
token is sitting on the quay crane. Containers themselves are the shared pool:
a stowed container can be assigned to whichever berth loop asks for it first, and
while assigned it is staged for that loop alone. Breaking a container's customs
seal draws the next number from the terminal's seal book, writes that number
against the container, and marks it released. A released container may later be
handed back to the pool for another job, and the number written against it stays
written; a container whose seal number is already recorded can never have its
seal broken again. A staged container may also be stood down and returned to the
pool untouched. The full action set is: assign a stowed container to a berth
loop, pass a berth loop's token to the next free crane, break a staged
container's customs seal from the quay crane, hand a released container back to
the pool, and stand a staged container down.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The seal numbers written against containers are exactly the
numbers zero up to one below the seal book's next number, with none missing and
none shared, so no container's customs seal was ever broken twice.

---- MODULE W4Od16m3p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, Rx, TermBound, MaxQuota

NoNode == "nonode"
NoTerm == TermBound

VARIABLES term, leader, status, stamp, ledger, quota

vars == <<term, leader, status, stamp, ledger, quota>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in 0 .. (TermBound - 1)
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NoNode}
  /\ status \in [Rx -> {"queued", "claimed", "filled"}]
  /\ stamp \in [Rx -> (0 .. (TermBound - 1)) \cup {NoTerm}]
  /\ ledger \in SUBSET Rx
  /\ quota \in 1 .. MaxQuota

Init ==
  /\ term = 0
  /\ leader = NoNode
  /\ status = [p \in Rx |-> "queued"]
  /\ stamp = [p \in Rx |-> NoTerm]
  /\ ledger = {}
  /\ quota = MaxQuota

Elect(n) ==
  /\ leader = NoNode
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ term' = (term + 1) % TermBound
  /\ UNCHANGED <<status, stamp, ledger, quota>>

StepDown ==
  /\ leader # NoNode
  /\ leader' = NoNode
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, status, stamp, ledger, quota>>

\* A claim is stamped with the term in force, and refuses anything the ledger
\* already knows about.
Claim(p) ==
  /\ leader # NoNode
  /\ status[p] = "queued"
  /\ p \notin ledger
  /\ Cardinality(ledger) < quota
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p] = "claimed"]
  /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![p] = term]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, ledger, quota>>

\* The irreversible act: only under a stamp that still matches the live term.
Dispense(p) ==
  /\ leader # NoNode
  /\ status[p] = "claimed"
  /\ stamp[p] = term
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p] = "filled"]
  /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![p] = NoTerm]
  /\ ledger' = ledger \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, quota>>

\* After a failover the old coordinator's claims no longer match; they go back.
Requeue(p) ==
  /\ status[p] = "claimed"
  /\ stamp[p] # term
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p] = "queued"]
  /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![p] = NoTerm]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, ledger, quota>>

Reprint(p) ==
  /\ status[p] = "filled"
  /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![p] = "queued"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, stamp, ledger, quota>>

\* The shift quota is reset while the bank is running.
SetQuota(q) ==
  /\ q # quota
  /\ quota' = q
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, status, stamp, ledger>>

Resolve(p) == Dispense(p) \/ Requeue(p)
AnyElect == \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)

Next ==
  \/ AnyElect
  \/ StepDown
  \/ \E p \in Rx : Claim(p) \/ Dispense(p) \/ Requeue(p) \/ Reprint(p)
  \/ \E q \in 1 .. MaxQuota : SetQuota(q)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ WF_vars(AnyElect)
  /\ \A p \in Rx : SF_vars(Resolve(p))

\* Once a prescription is in the dispense ledger it never again carries a live
\* claim, so the drug can never leave the canister for it twice.
NoSecondDispense ==
  \A p \in Rx :
    p \in ledger => (stamp[p] = NoTerm /\ status[p] # "claimed")

EveryClaimResolved ==
  \A p \in Rx : (status[p] = "claimed") ~> (status[p] # "claimed")
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {"n1", "n2"}
    Rx = {"p1", "p2"}
    TermBound = 3
    MaxQuota = 2
INVARIANT NoSecondDispense
PROPERTY EveryClaimResolved
nl:
A hospital pharmacy runs a bank of automated prescription dispensers under a
single elected coordinator node. The coordinator is elected for a term; if it
goes down the seat is vacated and a surviving node is elected for the next term,
with terms tracked in a small rotating window. Dispensing a controlled
prescription is the irreversible act here: the drug physically leaves the
canister and the prescription is written into the pharmacy's dispense ledger,
which is never erased. The flow is that the coordinator claims a queued
prescription, stamping the claim with the term in force at that moment, and then
dispenses it - but only while the stamp still matches the live term. After a
failover the new coordinator's term no longer matches any claim stamped by the
old one, so those stale claims are put back on the queue instead of being acted
on. A prescription already in the dispense ledger may be re-queued for a
paperwork reprint, but it can never be claimed for dispensing again. The
canister's per-shift quota is not fixed: the duty pharmacist resets it while the
bank is running, and a prescription may only be claimed while the number of
entries already in the dispense ledger is below the quota currently in force.
The full action set is: elect a coordinator for the next term, have the sitting
coordinator go down, claim a queued prescription under the live term, dispense a
freshly claimed prescription, put a stale claim back on the queue, re-queue a
ledgered prescription for reprint, and reset the shift quota.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No prescription that already appears in the dispense ledger is
ever carrying a live claim stamp or sitting in the claimed state, so the
irreversible dispense can happen at most once per prescription.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every claimed prescription is eventually resolved - either
dispensed or put back on the queue - so no claim is left hanging across a
failover.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m4p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Groups, Cars, QueueCap, DropBound

VARIABLES free, held, riding, queue, dropped

vars == <<free, held, riding, queue, dropped>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ free \in SUBSET Cars
  /\ held \in [Groups -> SUBSET Cars]
  /\ riding \in [Groups -> SUBSET Cars]
  /\ queue \in [Groups -> 0 .. QueueCap]
  /\ dropped \in [Groups -> 0 .. DropBound]

Init ==
  /\ free = Cars
  /\ held = [g \in Groups |-> {}]
  /\ riding = [g \in Groups |-> {}]
  /\ queue = [g \in Groups |-> 0]
  /\ dropped = [g \in Groups |-> 0]

Accept(g) ==
  /\ queue[g] < QueueCap
  /\ queue' = [queue EXCEPT ![g] = queue[g] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<free, held, riding, dropped>>

\* Backpressure: a full queue turns the call away rather than growing.
Drop(g) ==
  /\ queue[g] = QueueCap
  /\ dropped[g] < DropBound
  /\ dropped' = [dropped EXCEPT ![g] = dropped[g] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<free, held, riding, queue>>

\* Every car movement takes the car out of one place in the same step that puts
\* it into the next, which is what keeps the fleet accounted for.
Reserve(g, c) ==
  /\ c \in free
  /\ queue[g] > 0
  /\ free' = free \ {c}
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![g] = held[g] \cup {c}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<riding, queue, dropped>>

Send(g, c) ==
  /\ c \in held[g]
  /\ queue[g] > 0
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![g] = held[g] \ {c}]
  /\ riding' = [riding EXCEPT ![g] = riding[g] \cup {c}]
  /\ queue' = [queue EXCEPT ![g] = queue[g] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<free, dropped>>

Finish(g, c) ==
  /\ c \in riding[g]
  /\ riding' = [riding EXCEPT ![g] = riding[g] \ {c}]
  /\ free' = free \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, queue, dropped>>

Yield(g, c) ==
  /\ c \in held[g]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![g] = held[g] \ {c}]
  /\ free' = free \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<riding, queue, dropped>>

Next ==
  \/ \E g \in Groups : Accept(g) \/ Drop(g)
  \/ \E g \in Groups : \E c \in Cars :
       Reserve(g, c) \/ Send(g, c) \/ Finish(g, c) \/ Yield(g, c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: each car shows up in exactly one of the fleet's places.
Places(c) ==
  (IF c \in free THEN 1 ELSE 0)
  + Cardinality({g \in Groups : c \in held[g]})
  + Cardinality({g \in Groups : c \in riding[g]})

FleetConserved == \A c \in Cars : Places(c) = 1
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Groups = {"lowrise", "highrise"}
    Cars = {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
    QueueCap = 2
    DropBound = 2
INVARIANT FleetConserved
nl:
A skyscraper runs two independent dispatch groups - the low-rise group and the
high-rise group - over one shared pool of elevator cars. Each group keeps its own
bounded hall-call queue: a new hall call is accepted onto a group's queue only
while that queue is below its posted depth, and when the queue is at depth the
group applies backpressure and turns the call away instead, recording it as
dropped. Cars themselves are never duplicated and never vanish. A car is either
sitting in the shared idle pool, or reserved by exactly one of the two dispatch
groups, or running a trip for exactly one of the two groups - never in two of
those situations at once and never in none of them. A group with calls waiting
reserves a car out of the shared pool; it then sends a reserved car off on a
trip, which consumes one call from that group's queue; when the trip finishes the
car returns to the shared idle pool. A group may also give a reserved car back to
the pool without using it, which is how the two groups end up competing for the
same cars. The full action set is: accept a hall call onto a group's queue,
apply backpressure and drop a hall call from a full queue, reserve an idle car
for a group, send a reserved car on a trip, return a finished car to the idle
pool, and yield an unused reserved car back to the pool.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every car in the building is in exactly one place at every
instant - idle pool, reserved by one group, or running a trip for one group - so
no car is ever conjured up or lost as the two groups pass cars through the shared
pool.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m3p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, EpochBound

NoNode == "nonode"
Epochs == 0 .. EpochBound

VARIABLES epoch, leader, register, published, crashed, view

vars == <<epoch, leader, register, published, crashed, view>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in Epochs
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NoNode}
  /\ register \in [Epochs -> Nodes \cup {NoNode}]
  /\ published \in [Epochs -> Nodes \cup {NoNode}]
  /\ crashed \in SUBSET Nodes
  /\ view \in [Nodes -> Epochs]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ leader = NoNode
  /\ register = [e \in Epochs |-> NoNode]
  /\ published = [e \in Epochs |-> NoNode]
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ view = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

\* Election opens the next epoch and writes the winner into the register.
Elect(n) ==
  /\ leader = NoNode
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ epoch < EpochBound
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ register' = [register EXCEPT ![epoch + 1] = n]
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![n] = epoch + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<published, crashed>>

\* Only the sitting controller publishes, and only under a current epoch view.
Publish(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ view[n] = epoch
  /\ published[epoch] = NoNode
  /\ published' = [published EXCEPT ![epoch] = n]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, leader, register, crashed, view>>

\* A silent crash leaves the seat untouched; nobody is told.
Crash(n) ==
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, leader, register, published, view>>

Suspect ==
  /\ leader \in crashed
  /\ leader' = NoNode
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, register, published, crashed, view>>

\* A restarted node comes back believing the epoch it left on: epoch zero.
Restart(n) ==
  /\ n \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {n}
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![n] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, leader, register, published>>

Resync(n) ==
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ view[n] # epoch
  /\ view' = [view EXCEPT ![n] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, leader, register, published, crashed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n) \/ Publish(n) \/ Crash(n) \/ Restart(n) \/ Resync(n)
  \/ Suspect

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ WF_vars(Suspect)

\* Whoever published an epoch's imbalance is the node the register names as that
\* epoch's elected controller.
PublisherWasController ==
  \A e \in Epochs : published[e] # NoNode => published[e] = register[e]

DeadControllerReleased ==
  \A n \in Nodes :
    (leader = n /\ n \in crashed) ~> (leader # n \/ n \notin crashed)
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {"n1", "n2"}
    EpochBound = 2
INVARIANT PublisherWasController
PROPERTY DeadControllerReleased
nl:
A stock exchange's opening auction is driven by a small cluster of matching
engines, one of which holds the auction controller seat. The seat is filled by
election: electing a node opens a new auction epoch, records that node as the
elected controller of that epoch in the exchange's election register, and gives
the newly elected node a correct view of the epoch number. Only the sitting
controller may publish the auction's order imbalance for an epoch, and only while
its own view of the epoch number still agrees with the exchange's, and only into
an epoch slot that has not already been published. Any node may crash silently -
it simply stops, with no announcement and no change to the seat, so the cluster
can go on believing a dead node is still the controller until somebody suspects
it and vacates the seat. A crashed node may later be restarted, and it comes back
with a stale view of the epoch number and must resynchronise before it can be
trusted with anything. A live node that is behind can resynchronise its view at
any time. The full action set is: elect a node and open the next epoch, publish
the imbalance for the current epoch as the sitting controller, crash a node
silently, suspect a crashed controller and vacate the seat, restart a crashed
node with a stale view, and resynchronise a lagging node's view of the epoch.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every published imbalance sits in an epoch slot whose publisher
is exactly the node the election register names as that epoch's elected
controller, so no unauthorized node and no node acting on a stale epoch view ever
publishes.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: A controller seat held by a node that has crashed is always
eventually released, either by suspicion vacating it or by that node coming back,
so the cluster never stays wedged behind a dead controller.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m9p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Trackers, Capacity, EpochBound

VARIABLES epoch, allot, reserved, stamp, stored

vars == <<epoch, allot, reserved, stamp, stored>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0 .. (EpochBound - 1)
  /\ allot \in [Trackers -> 0 .. Capacity]
  /\ reserved \in [Trackers -> 0 .. Capacity]
  /\ stamp \in [Trackers -> 0 .. (EpochBound - 1)]
  /\ stored \in 0 .. Capacity

TotalReserved ==
  LET g[S \in SUBSET Trackers] ==
        IF S = {} THEN 0
        ELSE LET k == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN reserved[k] + g[S \ {k}]
  IN g[Trackers]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ allot = [k \in Trackers |-> Capacity]
  /\ reserved = [k \in Trackers |-> 0]
  /\ stamp = [k \in Trackers |-> 0]
  /\ stored = 0

\* Reconfiguration advances the epoch and re-cuts the allotments, but it never
\* cuts a tracker below reservations it is already holding.
Reconfigure(a) ==
  /\ \A k \in Trackers : a[k] >= reserved[k]
  /\ epoch' = (epoch + 1) % EpochBound
  /\ allot' = a
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, stamp, stored>>

\* Stamps left over from the previous plan must be refreshed before use.
Refresh(k) ==
  /\ stamp[k] # epoch
  /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![k] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, allot, reserved, stored>>

Reserve(k) ==
  /\ stamp[k] = epoch
  /\ reserved[k] < allot[k]
  /\ stored + TotalReserved < Capacity
  /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![k] = reserved[k] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, allot, stamp, stored>>

\* Committing turns a reservation into a unit on the shelf; the pair of counters
\* moves together so the shared cold room is never overdrawn.
Commit(k) ==
  /\ stamp[k] = epoch
  /\ reserved[k] > 0
  /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![k] = reserved[k] - 1]
  /\ stored' = stored + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, allot, stamp>>

Issue ==
  /\ stored > 0
  /\ stored' = stored - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, allot, reserved, stamp>>

Release(k) ==
  /\ reserved[k] > 0
  /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![k] = reserved[k] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, allot, stamp, stored>>

Next ==
  \/ \E a \in [Trackers -> 0 .. Capacity] : Reconfigure(a)
  \/ \E k \in Trackers : Refresh(k) \/ Reserve(k) \/ Commit(k) \/ Release(k)
  \/ Issue

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The shared cold room is never overcommitted, and no tracker outruns the
\* allotment the current plan gave it.
WithinCapacity ==
  /\ stored + TotalReserved =< Capacity
  /\ \A k \in Trackers : reserved[k] =< allot[k]
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Trackers = {"hospital", "registry"}
    Capacity = 3
    EpochBound = 2
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A regional blood bank tracks units of one blood group across a single shared cold
room. Two independent trackers write into that shared cold room: the hospital's
own inventory tracker and the regional registry's tracker. The cold room has a
hard physical capacity and the two trackers must live inside it together. The
storage plan is versioned by an epoch number: reconfiguring the plan advances the
epoch, kept in a small rotating window, and hands each tracker a fresh allotment
- the number of units that tracker may hold reserved at once. A reconfiguration
is never allowed to hand a tracker an allotment below what it already has
reserved. Each tracker carries a stamp saying which epoch its reservations were
taken under; after a reconfiguration that stamp is stale and the tracker must
refresh it before it may reserve anything further. Reserving a unit is allowed
only while the tracker is below its current allotment and only while the units
already in the cold room plus every unit reserved by either tracker still leave
room. Committing turns one of a tracker's reservations into a unit physically
sitting in the cold room; issuing takes a unit out of the cold room for a
patient; releasing gives a reservation back unused. The full action set is:
reconfigure the plan into the next epoch with new allotments, refresh a tracker's
stale stamp, reserve a unit, commit a reservation into the cold room, issue a
stored unit to a patient, and release a reservation unused.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The units sitting in the cold room plus every unit reserved by
either tracker never exceed the cold room's capacity, and neither tracker ever
holds more reservations than the allotment currently in force for it.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od13m2p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Machines, RoundBound

VARIABLES round, phase, roster, cookie, vote, forced

vars == <<round, phase, roster, cookie, vote, forced>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ round \in 0 .. (RoundBound - 1)
  /\ phase \in {"idle", "preparing", "committed", "aborted"}
  /\ roster \in SUBSET Machines
  /\ cookie \in [Machines -> 0 .. (RoundBound - 1)]
  /\ vote \in [Machines -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
  /\ forced \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ round = 0
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ roster = {}
  /\ cookie = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ vote = [m \in Machines |-> "none"]
  /\ forced = FALSE

Open ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ phase' = "preparing"
  /\ round' = (round + 1) % RoundBound
  /\ vote' = [m \in Machines |-> "none"]
  /\ forced' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<roster, cookie>>

Enlist(m) ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ m \notin roster
  /\ roster' = roster \cup {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, phase, cookie, vote, forced>>

\* Picking up the live cookie discards any vote cast under the previous one.
Resync(m) ==
  /\ cookie[m] # round
  /\ cookie' = [cookie EXCEPT ![m] = round]
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![m] = "none"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, phase, roster, forced>>

CastVote(m, v) ==
  /\ phase = "preparing"
  /\ m \in roster
  /\ cookie[m] = round
  /\ vote[m] = "none"
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![m] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, phase, roster, cookie, forced>>

Commit ==
  /\ phase = "preparing"
  /\ roster # {}
  /\ \A m \in roster : vote[m] = "yes" /\ cookie[m] = round
  /\ phase' = "committed"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, roster, cookie, vote, forced>>

Abort ==
  /\ phase = "preparing"
  /\ \E m \in roster : vote[m] = "no"
  /\ phase' = "aborted"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, roster, cookie, vote, forced>>

\* Privileged: the supervisor reissues the cookie mid-round, stranding every
\* recorded vote until its machine resynchronises.
Reissue ==
  /\ phase = "preparing"
  /\ round' = (round + 1) % RoundBound
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, roster, cookie, vote, forced>>

\* Privileged: the supervisor forces the decision outright.
ForceTo(d) ==
  /\ phase = "preparing"
  /\ phase' = d
  /\ forced' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, roster, cookie, vote>>

Force == \E d \in {"committed", "aborted"} : ForceTo(d)

Close ==
  /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<round, roster, cookie, vote, forced>>

Next ==
  \/ Open \/ Commit \/ Abort \/ Reissue \/ Force \/ Close
  \/ \E m \in Machines : Enlist(m) \/ Resync(m)
  \/ \E m \in Machines : \E v \in {"yes", "no"} : CastVote(m, v)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ WF_vars(Force)

\* A standing commit is either the supervisor's forced call or is carried by a
\* non-empty roster all of whose votes are yes under the live cookie.
CommitIsProperlyBacked ==
  (phase = "committed") =>
    \/ forced
    \/ (roster # {} /\ \A m \in roster : vote[m] = "yes" /\ cookie[m] = round)

EveryRoundDecides == (phase = "preparing") ~> (phase # "preparing")
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Machines = {"m1", "m2"}
    RoundBound = 3
INVARIANT CommitIsProperlyBacked
PROPERTY EveryRoundDecides
nl:
A vending machine network settles each day's route takings with a two-phase
commit run by the route controller over the machines on its roster. A settlement
round is opened with a fresh round cookie; only machines on the roster may take
part, and a machine may cast a prepare vote only while the cookie it is holding
still equals the round's live cookie. Machines pick up the live cookie by
resynchronising, and resynchronising wipes whatever vote that machine had
recorded, because a vote cast under an old cookie means nothing under the new
one. The route supervisor is privileged in two ways. It may reissue the round
cookie in the middle of a round, which leaves every machine holding a stale
cookie and every recorded vote unconfirmed until each machine resynchronises and
votes again; and it may force the round to a decision outright, committing or
aborting it without waiting for anybody, in which case the decision is marked as
forced. Left to itself the round commits only when the roster is non-empty and
every rostered machine has a yes vote standing under the live cookie, and aborts
as soon as any rostered machine votes no. A decided round is closed and the
controller goes back to idle. The full action set is: open a round, add a machine
to the roster between rounds while the controller is idle, resynchronise a machine's cookie and clear its vote, cast a vote,
commit on unanimity, abort on a no vote, reissue the round cookie, force a
decision as supervisor, and close a decided round.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a round stands committed, either the supervisor forced
it or the roster is non-empty and every rostered machine has a yes vote standing
under the round's live cookie, so no commit is ever carried by an off-roster
machine or by a vote left over from a stale cookie.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every opened settlement round is eventually decided, because
the supervisor's override is always available to break a round that is going
nowhere.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m2p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Gangs, TxnBound

VARIABLES txn, phase, ticket, tally, crashed, certificate

vars == <<txn, phase, ticket, tally, crashed, certificate>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ txn \in 0 .. (TxnBound - 1)
  /\ phase \in {"idle", "collecting", "committed", "aborted"}
  /\ ticket \in [Gangs -> 0 .. (TxnBound - 1)]
  /\ tally \in SUBSET Gangs
  /\ crashed \in SUBSET Gangs
  /\ certificate \in SUBSET Gangs

Init ==
  /\ txn = 0
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ ticket = [g \in Gangs |-> 0]
  /\ tally = {}
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ certificate = {}

Open ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ phase' = "collecting"
  /\ txn' = (txn + 1) % TxnBound
  /\ certificate' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ticket, tally, crashed>>

\* A reply is a ticket stamped with the live transaction plus a place in the tally.
Reply(g) ==
  /\ phase = "collecting"
  /\ g \notin crashed
  /\ ticket[g] # txn
  /\ ticket' = [ticket EXCEPT ![g] = txn]
  /\ tally' = tally \cup {g}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, phase, crashed, certificate>>

\* Silent failure: nothing the controller can observe changes.
CrashSilently(g) ==
  /\ g \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {g}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, phase, ticket, tally, certificate>>

Restart(g) ==
  /\ g \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {g}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, phase, ticket, tally, certificate>>

\* Striking a suspected gang is only legal while replies are still being collected.
TimeOut(g) ==
  /\ phase = "collecting"
  /\ g \in tally
  /\ tally' = tally \ {g}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, phase, ticket, crashed, certificate>>

Commit ==
  /\ phase = "collecting"
  /\ \A g \in Gangs : g \in tally /\ ticket[g] = txn
  /\ phase' = "committed"
  /\ certificate' = {g \in tally : ticket[g] = txn}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, ticket, tally, crashed>>

Abort ==
  /\ phase = "collecting"
  /\ \E g \in Gangs : g \notin tally
  /\ phase' = "aborted"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, ticket, tally, crashed, certificate>>

\* The tally is left standing on purpose; only the certificate is reset.
Close ==
  /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<txn, ticket, tally, crashed, certificate>>

Next ==
  \/ Open \/ Commit \/ Abort \/ Close
  \/ \E g \in Gangs : Reply(g) \/ CrashSilently(g) \/ Restart(g) \/ TimeOut(g)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Nobody on the certificate is a stale or absent participant.
CertificateIsSound ==
  \A g \in certificate : g \in tally /\ ticket[g] = txn
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Gangs = {"g1", "g2"}
    TxnBound = 3
INVARIANT CertificateIsSound
nl:
A container terminal changes its stowage plan through a two-phase commit run by
the yard controller across the crane gangs working the ship. Each plan change
carries a transaction number, kept in a small rotating window. When a change is
opened the controller wipes any commit certificate from the previous change and
begins collecting prepare replies. A gang replies by taking a ticket stamped with
the live transaction number and joining the controller's prepare tally; a gang
whose ticket still carries an older number has not really replied to this change
at all. Any gang can go down silently at any moment - it just stops answering,
with no signal to the controller and no change to anything the controller can
see - and a gang that is down may later come back up. Because the controller
cannot tell a silent failure from slowness, it may time a gang out and strike it
from the prepare tally, but only while the change is still collecting replies.
The change commits only when every gang is in the tally with a ticket stamped for
the live transaction, and committing writes the backing gangs into the commit
certificate. If a gang has been struck from the tally the change is aborted
instead. A decided change is closed and the controller returns to idle, and the
prepare tally is deliberately left standing so a later change can see who
answered last time. The full action set is: open a plan change, have a gang take
a ticket and join the tally, crash a gang silently, restart a downed gang, time a
gang out of the tally, commit and write the certificate, abort a change missing a
gang, and close a decided change.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every gang named on the standing commit certificate is still in
the controller's prepare tally holding a ticket stamped with the live transaction
number, so no gang that never answered and no gang whose ticket has gone stale is
ever counted as backing a committed plan change.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od11m1p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS RingSize, JobsPerStation

Stations == 1 .. RingSize
Jobs == Stations \X (1 .. JobsPerStation)

OwnerOf(j) == j[1]

VARIABLES token, spool, ledger, receipts, managerOpen

vars == <<token, spool, ledger, receipts, managerOpen>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Stations
  /\ spool \in SUBSET Jobs
  /\ ledger \in SUBSET Jobs
  /\ receipts \in SUBSET Jobs
  /\ managerOpen \in SUBSET Jobs

Init ==
  /\ token = 1
  /\ spool = {}
  /\ ledger = {}
  /\ receipts = {}
  /\ managerOpen = {}

PassToken ==
  /\ token' = (token % RingSize) + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<spool, ledger, receipts, managerOpen>>

TakeIn(j) ==
  /\ j \notin spool
  /\ j \notin ledger
  /\ spool' = spool \cup {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, ledger, receipts, managerOpen>>

\* Only the token holder writes the shared ledger, and it keeps a receipt.
Post(j) ==
  /\ token = OwnerOf(j)
  /\ j \in spool
  /\ spool' = spool \ {j}
  /\ ledger' = ledger \cup {j}
  /\ receipts' = receipts \cup {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, managerOpen>>

\* The manager's override skips the ring entirely and posts under its own name.
ManagerPost(j) ==
  /\ j \in spool
  /\ spool' = spool \ {j}
  /\ ledger' = ledger \cup {j}
  /\ managerOpen' = managerOpen \cup {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, receipts>>

DiscardReceipt(j) ==
  /\ j \in receipts
  /\ receipts' = receipts \ {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, spool, ledger, managerOpen>>

ReleasePosting(j) ==
  /\ j \in managerOpen
  /\ managerOpen' = managerOpen \ {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, spool, ledger, receipts>>

\* The purge may only strike entries nobody still holds paper against.
Purge(j) ==
  /\ j \in ledger
  /\ j \notin receipts
  /\ j \notin managerOpen
  /\ ledger' = ledger \ {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, spool, receipts, managerOpen>>

Next ==
  \/ PassToken
  \/ \E j \in Jobs :
       TakeIn(j) \/ Post(j) \/ ManagerPost(j)
         \/ DiscardReceipt(j) \/ ReleasePosting(j) \/ Purge(j)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ WF_vars(PassToken)
  /\ \A j \in Jobs : SF_vars(Post(j))

\* No update is lost from the shared ledger while a receipt or an open manager
\* posting still refers to it.
NoLostBilling == (receipts \cup managerOpen) \subseteq ledger

EveryJobBilled == \A j \in Jobs : (j \in spool) ~> (j \in ledger)
====
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    RingSize = 3
    JobsPerStation = 1
INVARIANT NoLostBilling
PROPERTY EveryJobBilled
nl:
A print shop spools its jobs through a ring of counter stations, and the shop's
single shared billing ledger is written only by whichever station currently holds
the ring token. Each job belongs to the station that took it in. A station with
the token folds one of its own spooled jobs into the shared ledger and keeps a
receipt for it; the receipt is the station's own proof that the job was billed.
The shop manager is privileged and does not queue for the token: the manager can
post any spooled job straight into the shared ledger, which is how a job gets
billed when its station is tied up, and such a posting is held open under the
manager's own name until the manager releases it. Nothing is allowed to quietly
remove an entry from the shared ledger while somebody is still holding paper
against it: the nightly purge may strike a ledger entry only once no station
receipt and no open manager posting refers to it. Stations discard receipts when
their local logs rotate, and the manager releases postings once the day's
reconciliation is done. New jobs arrive into the spool at any time. The full
action set is: pass the token to the next station in the ring, take a new job
into the spool, post a spooled job to the ledger under the token, post a spooled
job by manager override, discard a station receipt, release a manager posting,
and purge an unreferenced ledger entry.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every job that a station still holds a receipt for and every job
the manager still has posted open is present in the shared billing ledger, so no
billing update is ever lost from the shared record while somebody is still
counting on it.

LIVENESS PROPERTY: Every job sitting in the spool is eventually billed into the
shared ledger, because the token keeps coming back round to the station that owns
it.

---- MODULE W4Od0m0p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Desks, Rooms, RoomCap, TeamCap, VerBound, RetryBound

NoRoom == "noroom"
NoSnap == VerBound

VARIABLES version, booked, snap, target, retries

vars == <<version, booked, snap, target, retries>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ version \in 0 .. (VerBound - 1)
  /\ booked \in [Rooms -> 0 .. RoomCap]
  /\ snap \in [Desks -> (0 .. (VerBound - 1)) \cup {NoSnap}]
  /\ target \in [Desks -> Rooms \cup {NoRoom}]
  /\ retries \in [Desks -> 0 .. RetryBound]

Scheduled ==
  LET g[S \in SUBSET Rooms] ==
        IF S = {} THEN 0
        ELSE LET r == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN booked[r] + g[S \ {r}]
  IN g[Rooms]

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ booked = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]
  /\ snap = [d \in Desks |-> NoSnap]
  /\ target = [d \in Desks |-> NoRoom]
  /\ retries = [d \in Desks |-> 0]

\* Optimistic read: the desk records the version it saw and the room it wants.
Read(d, r) ==
  /\ snap[d] = NoSnap
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = version]
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![d] = r]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, booked, retries>>

\* A commit needs an unchanged version and headroom at both ceilings.
CommitOK(d) ==
  /\ snap[d] = version
  /\ target[d] # NoRoom
  /\ booked[target[d]] < RoomCap
  /\ Scheduled < TeamCap

Commit(d) ==
  /\ CommitOK(d)
  /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![target[d]] = booked[target[d]] + 1]
  /\ version' = (version + 1) % VerBound
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![d] = NoRoom]
  /\ UNCHANGED retries

\* Stale snapshot or no headroom: throw the attempt away and start over.
Retry(d) ==
  /\ snap[d] # NoSnap
  /\ ~CommitOK(d)
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
  /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![d] = NoRoom]
  /\ retries' = [retries EXCEPT ![d] =
                   IF retries[d] < RetryBound THEN retries[d] + 1 ELSE retries[d]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, booked>>

Release(r) ==
  /\ booked[r] > 0
  /\ booked' = [booked EXCEPT ![r] = booked[r] - 1]
  /\ version' = (version + 1) % VerBound
  /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, target, retries>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Desks : \E r \in Rooms : Read(d, r)
  \/ \E d \in Desks : Commit(d) \/ Retry(d)
  \/ \E r \in Rooms : Release(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Both ceilings hold: per-room block ceiling and the hospital-wide team ceiling
\* over the shared pool.
WithinCapacity ==
  /\ \A r \in Rooms : booked[r] =< RoomCap
  /\ Scheduled =< TeamCap
====

SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Desks = {"elective", "intake"}
    Rooms = {"r1", "r2"}
    RoomCap = 2
    TeamCap = 3
    VerBound = 3
    RetryBound = 2
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A hospital books operating rooms through two independent front desks - the
elective surgical desk and the emergency intake desk - and both write into one
shared theatre plan covering the same pool of rooms. The plan carries a version
number in a small rotating window, and the desks work optimistically rather than
holding anything: a desk reads the plan's current version as a snapshot and picks
the room it wants, then tries to commit its booking. The commit goes through only
if the snapshot still equals the plan's live version, if the chosen room is still
below its own block ceiling of scheduled cases, and if the whole hospital is still
below its ceiling of staffed anaesthesia teams across all rooms. A successful
commit adds the case to the room, advances the plan version - which is what makes
the other desk's snapshot go out of date - and clears the desk back to empty. If
the snapshot has gone stale, or the room ceiling is reached, or no anaesthesia
team is left, the desk throws its attempt away, counts a retry against itself and
starts over. Cases are also taken off the plan when they finish, which likewise
advances the version. The full action set is: a desk reads a snapshot and picks a
room, a desk commits its booking, a desk retries after a failed attempt, and a
finished case is released from a room.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No operating room ever holds more scheduled cases than its block
ceiling, and the number of cases scheduled across the whole shared pool never
exceeds the number of staffed anaesthesia teams.

---- MODULE W4Od15m9p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Firms, EpochBound

Epochs == 0 .. EpochBound
NoCred == EpochBound + 1

VARIABLES epoch, cred, admissions, accepted, pending

vars == <<epoch, cred, admissions, accepted, pending>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in Epochs
  /\ cred \in [Firms -> Epochs \cup {NoCred}]
  /\ admissions \in [Epochs -> SUBSET Firms]
  /\ accepted \in [Epochs -> SUBSET Firms]
  /\ pending \in [Firms -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ cred = [f \in Firms |-> 0]
  /\ admissions = [e \in Epochs |-> IF e = 0 THEN Firms ELSE {}]
  /\ accepted = [e \in Epochs |-> {}]
  /\ pending = [f \in Firms |-> FALSE]

\* Reconfiguration advances the epoch and thereby stales every credential.
Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < EpochBound
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<cred, admissions, accepted, pending>>

\* Ordinary renewal requires unbroken membership across the epoch boundary.
Renew(f) ==
  /\ cred[f] # epoch
  /\ epoch > 0
  /\ cred[f] = epoch - 1
  /\ cred' = [cred EXCEPT ![f] = epoch]
  /\ admissions' = [admissions EXCEPT ![epoch] = admissions[epoch] \cup {f}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, accepted, pending>>

\* The market-operations override: no continuity needed, but still booked.
OfficerGrant(f) ==
  /\ cred[f] # epoch
  /\ cred' = [cred EXCEPT ![f] = epoch]
  /\ admissions' = [admissions EXCEPT ![epoch] = admissions[epoch] \cup {f}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, accepted, pending>>

PutIn(f) ==
  /\ ~pending[f]
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![f] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cred, admissions, accepted>>

Accept(f) ==
  /\ pending[f]
  /\ cred[f] = epoch
  /\ accepted' = [accepted EXCEPT ![epoch] = accepted[epoch] \cup {f}]
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![f] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cred, admissions>>

TurnAway(f) ==
  /\ pending[f]
  /\ cred[f] # epoch
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![f] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cred, admissions, accepted>>

Resolve(f) == Accept(f) \/ TurnAway(f)

Next ==
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E f \in Firms : Renew(f) \/ OfficerGrant(f) \/ PutIn(f) \/ Accept(f) \/ TurnAway(f)

Spec ==
  /\ Init
  /\ [][Next]_vars
  /\ \A f \in Firms : WF_vars(Resolve(f))

\* Every accepted order in an epoch belongs to a firm booked into that epoch's
\* admissions, and no epoch past the live one has accepted anything.
OrdersAreCredentialed ==
  /\ \A e \in Epochs : accepted[e] \subseteq admissions[e]
  /\ \A e \in Epochs : e > epoch => accepted[e] = {}

EveryOrderResolved ==
  \A f \in Firms : pending[f] ~> ~pending[f]
====
